notes: Added the browser extension for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek: browse, search, export and clean up web chats, and sync them into Stacker.
Added distillation of web chats, local sessions and excerpts into reusable results and skill drafts.
Added a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-style gateway over agent CLIs, per-agent API service settings, and session summaries with project handoffs.
Agent latest versions now come from each vendor's own update service, labelled with their source; MiMo Desktop and the moved OpenClaw Windows companion are supported.
Parallel agent tasks with waiting reasons, real download progress and clearable history.
Updates are now signed and verified with a built-in public key before they are installed.
